sources.evidence: TV media spend: Weekly, vendor media-buying week (Monday to Sunday).
sources.transform: Allocate each complete source week over its seven dates, then aggregate by calendar month. Uniform daily delivery is a project assumption, not a vendor fact.

sources.evidence: Digital / email spend: Monthly, calendar month.
sources.transform: Retain calendar-month grain. Do not invent weekly observations by repeating monthly values.
Join one-to-one on complete calendar months after TV correction.

flags.issue: Weekly TV cannot be assigned wholly to its label month; actual dates must establish each Monday–Sunday interval.
flags.verification: Validate starts, ends and seven-day intervals; boundary allocation tests.

flags.issue: Monthly digital, email and sales must retain calendar-month grain.
flags.verification: Check canonical unique months and exact joins.

flags.issue: Apportionment must conserve weekly spend before any cropping.
flags.verification: Check source total against the full expanded daily calendar; separately reconcile cropped overlaps.

flags.issue: Source currency and scale are absent; project units do not verify real vendor units.
flags.verification: Obtain vendor currency/scale confirmation. Synthetic data use an explicit shared unit contract.

flags.issue: 4-4-5 quarters do not define the fiscal-year anchor or label convention, including possible 53-week years.
flags.verification: Request fiscal calendar and label dictionary. This pipeline uses explicit week_start/week_end dates rather than inferred fiscal labels.

flags.issue: Uniform daily TV delivery cannot be established from weekly totals; campaign-day data may change the split.
flags.verification: Request actual daily delivery. Use equal sevenths only as a disclosed synthetic assumption; check boundary and full-month coverage.

modellingWarnings: Calendar reconciliation establishes timing consistency, not causal identification.
